message: #link V_spec is not a valid module name
why: A #link payload is a *module name*, not a file name — it resolves to <name>.hbc. Writing a suffix or a path makes people think absolute paths work, and then builds that work on one machine fail on another.
fix: if the library lives elsewhere, point -L at its directory instead of putting a path in the source
